title: スプリンターズSの後に・まことの風へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First she won a mile, and now Yamanin Zephyr has conquered a sprint too. All that's left is to win the medium-distance autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's set her sights on achieving a feat that not even the Mile Emperor could manage. There has to be more I can do to help her realize that goal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to set up a joint training session with other runners scheduled to enter the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grateful for the opportunity, Yamanin Zephyr throws herself into the final leg of her training for our next goal.
